shared: All three are a weather court whose units Gust: they make extra attacks out of turn.
differ: Each adds a different twist: play-order carries, units fighting from hand, or courtiers giving up attacks.

takes.label: Crown your last play
takes.line: Your last-played unit, any tribe, is Announced and soaks the Court's buffs, so every shop turn asks who goes last.
takes.look_if: a play-order puzzle each shop turn, with any tribe's unit as carry.

takes.label: The army in hand
takes.line: Late units wait in your hand and land mid-fight; Lady High Pressure holds every Gust back, then releases them doubled.
takes.look_if: a timing puzzle, with a second army dropping in mid-fight.

takes.label: Bow to the favourite
takes.line: Defer courtiers skip their attacks so your biggest unit Gusts instead, and a Gale dial pays Gusts back as gold and stats.
takes.look_if: fights that feed the shop, and one unit doing all the hitting.
